# Keith's K9 Care, dog grooming, Hall Green, Wakefield WF4

> IPET-qualified dog grooming from a calm, one-dog-at-a-time home salon at 4 Castle Meadows, Hall Green, Wakefield WF4 3QJ, two minutes from Newmillerdam Country Park. Full grooms, puppy first grooms, bath & tidy. Prices are published on the site; one dog at a time; welfare-first.
